inlines.v: CIRCENSIAN, adjective Pertaining to the Circus, in Rome, where were practiced games of various kinds, as running, wrestling, combats, etc. The circensian games accompanied most of the feasts of the Romans; but the grand games were held five days, commencing on the 15th of September.
